race.title: Dane Architectural Systems Millionaire EBF 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: NIKOLAVS OTTO caught the eye in a Perth maiden that has worked out very well and could be the value play up against Willie Mullins' Leader Allen , who's likely to be a warm order. NIKOLAVS OTTO (IRE) LEADER ALLEN (FR) MEASURE OF A MAN (IRE)
